news.title: Amputee World Cup: Black Challenge thrash Iraq to secure Round of 16 spot at Amputee World Cup
news.lede: Ghana’s Black Challenge thrashed Iraq 6-0 in their final group game of the WAFF Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico to secure qualification for the Round of 16. Ghana headed into the encounter desperately needing a convincing victory to boost their chances of progressing to the knockout stage after suffering a 2-0 defeat to Angola and playing out a 1-1 draw with Colombia. Coach Richard Obeng’s side made their intentions clear early on, with star player Mohammed Mubarik opening the scoring with a stunning long-range strike to give Ghana the lead. Hamza Mohammed then doubled the advantage as the Black Challenge took control of the encounter, growing in confidence and piling pressure on their opponents.

news.title: 'Dreaming costs nothing' - Santos star Neymar fuels hopes of wearing Brazil's yellow shirt again ahead of 2028 Copa America and 2030 World Cup
news.lede: Santos forward Neymar has refused to rule out a future return to the Brazil national team after being quizzed about the next Copa America and the 2030 World Cup. Attending a Kings League Cup match in Guarulhos on Monday, the veteran attacker admitted that he still dreams of pulling on his country's famous yellow jersey once again. Forward hints at international comeback Neymar sparked fresh optimism among Brazilian supporters regarding a potential Selecao recall while attending Furia's clash against Funkbol at the Trident Arena in Sao Paulo's metropolitan region. Serving as co-president of Furia alongside close friend Cris Guedes, the Santos No. 10 arrived at the venue accompanied by club team-mates Philippe Coutinho and Arthur.

news.title: European football body’s plan to go global leaves Fifa on tenterhooks
news.lede: Findings of ‘feasibility study’ into quest for world domination loom with Europe’s wealthiest certain to benefit whatever the outcome. It will be one of the most eagerly devoured documents in football circles, assuming its contents are ever fully revealed. In September, the increasingly powerful European Football Clubs body announced a “feasibility study” into how it can become established on a more global scale, morphing into an organisation that represents clubs all over the world. The study’s findings could, some leading figures in the sport’s governance believe, define football’s long-term future.

news.title: Des Buckingham appointed New Zealand coach through to 2030 World Cup
news.lede: Des Buckingham will take charge of New Zealand from July 2027. Former New Zealand under-23 coach Des Buckingham will take over the senior side from July 2027 and lead the All Whites through to the 2030 World Cup, New Zealand Football (NZF) said on Nov 17. The 41-year-old Englishman will also lead the Under-23 side as they look to qualify for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. “Des is a unique candidate for this role as he has a deep connection to New Zealand and the game here, as well as experience of coaching around the world at the highest levels with significant success across a wide range of environments,” NZF boss Andrew Pragnell said in a statement.

news.title: Des Buckingham to lead All Whites through to the 2030 FIFA World Cup
news.lede: Former Wellington Phoenix and New Zealand age-group coach Des Buckingham has been named as the next head coach of the All Whites. Buckingham (41) will take up the role on July 1, 2027, and lead the national team through to the 2030 FIFA Men’s World Cup. He will also lead the national men’s U-23 team as they prepare for the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles. Buckingham is in his second season as head coach of Saudi Pro League club Al-Kholood and will complete his commitments there before joining NZ Football.
